{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count the number of unique patients after deduplication
num_patients = len(data_dedup)

# Step 2: Check assay_batch — batch B reports in µg/L, not ng/mL
# Convert batch B values to ng/mL: divide by 10 (since 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL)
data_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = data_dedup['biomarker_final']
mask_batch_b = data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
data_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final_ngml'] = data_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final = data_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

# Print all necessary values
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {num_patients}")
print(f"Number of patients with assay_batch == 'B': {mask_batch_b.sum()}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
